# Ebrostay

> Mid-term corporate rental marketplace in Zaragoza, Spain. Furnished homes
> for whole-month stays of 1 to 11 months, aimed at companies housing their
> people and at property owners listing their homes. Fully bilingual
> (Spanish/English), booking requests online with no upfront payment.

Key facts:

- Stays are billed in whole months (1–11); prices are shown per month.
- Any signed-in user can list a property; the Ebrostay team reviews every
  listing before it is published.
- Booking flow: search, review a verified home, send a booking request —
  payment and the refundable deposit are agreed separately, nothing is
  charged online.
- Based in Zaragoza (Spain); the name and logo refer to the stone bridge
  (Puente de Piedra) over the river Ebro.
